commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor Nova main flow into focused methods
commitResults.messageBody: Extract welcome rendering, command-loop processing, and goodbye rendering from Nova.main. The previous method combined several responsibilities and exceeded the code-quality guideline's warning threshold for long methods, making the program flow harder to scan and maintain. Named constants centralize the repeated divider, banner, and exit command values, while the extracted methods keep each section at a single level of abstraction. Preserve the existing command handling, output order, and scanner lifecycle.

Restrict Task's description and completion state to the Task class by changing both fields from protected to private. Neither Todo, Deadline, nor Event accesses these fields directly; they rely on Task's public behavior, so this preserves runtime behavior while preventing subclasses from coupling to the internal representation. This applies the code-quality guideline to minimize variable scope and strengthens encapsulation for future maintenance.

Consolidate the shared workflow used by the mark and unmark commands into updateTaskStatus. The previous implementations duplicated task-number parsing, task lookup, status updates, and user feedback, which made the two paths harder to maintain consistently and violated the DRY principle from the NUS code-quality guidelines. Keep the command-specific confirmation text and desired status at the call sites while centralizing the common workflow. Preserve the existing command behavior and output.

Make the Event time range and Deadline due date private and final. These fields are implementation details, and repository-wide usage confirms that no subclass or external class needs direct access to them. Restricting access prevents accidental mutation or coupling to the internal representation, while final fields communicate that these values are fixed after construction. Runtime behavior and task display output remain unchanged.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract console interaction into Ui to separate presentation from task logic
commitResults.messageBody:
Console input and output were spread across Nova, CommandHandler, and
TaskList. Introduce nova.ui.Ui to own the scanner, welcome and goodbye
messages, dividers, error display, task listings, and confirmations.
Pass the same Ui to CommandHandler and close it through try-with-resources
in Nova. Keep command syntax, displayed text, and persistence behavior
unchanged while removing console output from TaskList.

Add process-level console regression tests for normal commands, validation
errors, restarts, EOF, and corrupt saves. Compare complete transcripts and
saved data in isolated temporary folders, and allow testing a previous
compiled build against the same expectations.

Correct the pre-existing storage test and documentation that still assumed
a 100-task limit: TaskList already uses ArrayList. Verify that task 101 can
be added, saved, reloaded, and marked without changing production capacity.
Document class responsibilities and the PowerShell test commands.

Validation on Java 25.0.4:
- Compile all main and test sources with javac -Xlint:all (no warnings).
- Pass all five console scenarios against both the baseline and new build.
- Pass the complete corrected StorageTest suite, including I/O failures.
- Pass git diff --check.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract AddCommand to share task-addition execution across task types
commitResults.messageBody:
Introduce an abstract Command with execute(tasks, ui, storage) and a
default non-exiting isExit() contract as the first step toward executing
all user actions uniformly.

Todo, deadline, and event additions repeated the same list update and UI
confirmation before CommandHandler saved the list. Move those execution
steps and their save into AddCommand, which accepts an already parsed
Task. Keep parsing and validation in CommandHandler for this increment;
its add parsing methods now return Command objects ready to execute.
Return after each delegated addition so the handler does not save twice.

Preserve command syntax, console messages, saved task data, and the
existing behavior that a failed save leaves the addition in memory.
Document the command boundary and the remaining incremental extraction.

Extend storage regression coverage to execute prepared commands through
the abstract API, check that construction has no task or save effects,
and verify exactly one save attempt for each modifying command. Listing
and invalid commands must not attempt a save.

Validation on Java 25.0.4:
- Compile all main and test sources with javac -Xlint:all (no warnings).
- Pass all five console scenarios against baseline and refactored builds.
- Pass the full storage suite, including command and save-failure checks.
- Pass git diff --check.

commitResults.messageTitle: Parse deadline dates as LocalDate and separate display from persistence
commitResults.messageBody:
Deadlines previously stored arbitrary text, so impossible calendar dates
were accepted and the same string was used for display and storage.
Make Deadline hold and return LocalDate, parse ISO yyyy-MM-dd input before
creating AddCommand, and display dates as English MMM dd uuuu values such
as Oct 15 2019. Reject invalid dates with a useful format example before
the task list or saved file can change.

Keep deadline dates in ISO form in storage and parse them when loading.
Wrap invalid saved dates in the existing line-numbered loading error so
Nova stops without overwriting the file. Older free-text values require
explicit correction; do not guess missing years. Document this date-only
scope and the input, display, and saved-file formats.

Update fixtures and add regression coverage for typed date round trips,
leap-year and century rules, invalid input with no mutations or saves,
English month names under a French default locale, and completed dates
surviving a restart. Check that invalid or legacy dates in saved files
produce helpful errors while preserving the complete file.

Validation on Java 25.0.4:
- Baseline console and storage suites pass before the feature change.
- Compile all main and test sources with javac -Xlint:all (no warnings).
- All seven updated console scenarios pass with exact transcript checks.
- The full storage suite passes, including calendar and persistence tests.
- git diff --check passes.
